newsitem.title: UK: LASMO says hedges 19 pct of output on swaps market.
newsitem.headline: LASMO says hedges 19 pct of output on swaps market.

text.p: British oil explorer LASMO on Thursday said that last year it hedged 19 percent of its crude production by using oil swaps up to seven months forward.
Announcing annual results LASMO said by the end of 1996 it had oil swaps outstanding for two million barrels in the first quarter 1997, or 22,000 barrels a day (bpd).
In addition it had also hedged with swaps 9,900 bpd of second quarter output and 1,100 bpd of third quarter output.
LASMO said the swaps covered 19 percent of its output. The company hopes to reach 200,000 bpd of oil equivalent in output this year.
